core.name: Nirvana
core.text:
Anomaly Proficiency +85.
When any squad member deals Attribute Anomaly DMG, the enemy is Seared (Searing Corrosion) for 20s. Attribute Anomaly DMG on Seared enemies can CRIT: 30% Rate and 25% DMG, +0.7% Rate per point of her initial Anomaly Mastery above 155, maxing out at 255.
Every 8s Seared enemies take Fire DMG equal to 50% of her ATK, counted as EX Special Attack DMG.
During Blazing Assault she has higher Anti-Interrupt, builds Pyreflame by dealing DMG (max 120), and skips the backstep of Fire Snatch and Blazing Slash. Perfect Blocks give 5 Pyreflame (once per 10s).
Fatal DMG doesn't take her down: next time she comes in she restores 50% Max HP (once per 1,200s in Withering Domain).
EX Specials put her in Wax and Wane for 20s; there, the next Dazzling Flare after one becomes Falling Sun.
